pages.en:
Special Branch,
December 21, 1932.

Arrival of the Japanese Training Squadron

The Japanese Naval Training Squadron comprising
the "Iwate", flagship of Vice-Admiral Hyakutake, Commander,
and the "Yagumo" will arrive in Shanghai at 10 a.m.
December 22 and berth at the N.Y.K. Hongkew Mail Wharf.

The programme during their stay in Shanghai as
obtained from Captain Kitaoka, Japanese Naval Attache,
is as follows :-

December 22 :

Following the arrival the Admiral will receive
on board his flagship Japanese officials and
representatives of public bodies, Naval
Commanders of foreign powers and the Chinese
Naval Commander. He will then visit the
Japanese Consulate-General.

Noon : Tiffin on board the "Idzumo".

During the afternoon : Visits to foreign
warships and the
Chinese Naval Headquarters
to return the calls.
Call on Mr. A.D. Bell,
Chairman of the Shanghai
Municipal Council.

Evening : Visit to the Japanese Club, Boone
Road, to interview local leading
Japanese residents.
Reception at the Japanese Minister's
residence, No.17 Rue Pichon, French
Concession.

December 23 :

Morning : The Admiral will visit the following
places :
Headquarters of the Japanese Landing
Party.
The Japanese Cemetery, Chapei.
The Commercial Press Building, Chapei.
Kiangwan.

Noon : Tiffin party on board the flagship.
Representatives of the various foreign
Powers, the Chinese Authorities and
the S.M.C. will be invited.

2 p.m. to "at home" on board the flagship.
4 p.m.

Evening : Reception in the Japanese Club.

特别科，
1932年12月21日。

日本海军练习舰队抵沪

由司令百武（Hyakutake）中将旗舰“岩手”号（Iwate）及“八云”号（Yagumo）组成的日本海军练习舰队，将于12月22日上午10时抵达上海，并停靠日本邮船会社虹口邮件码头。

根据日本海军武官北冈（Kitaoka）上校提供的信息，该舰队在沪期间的日程安排如下：

12月22日：

抵达后，中将将在其旗舰上接见日本官员、公共团体代表、各国海军指挥官及中国海军指挥官。随后，他将访问日本总领事馆。

中午：在“出云”号（Idzumo）舰上午餐。

下午：回访外国军舰及中国海军司令部。
拜会上海工部局总董贝尔（A.D. Bell）先生。

晚上：访问位于布恩路（Boone Road）的日本俱乐部，会见当地日本侨领。
在法租界皮雄路（Rue Pichon）17号日本公使寓所举行招待会。

12月23日：

上午：中将将访问以下地点：
日本海军陆战队司令部。
闸北日本公墓。
闸北商务印书馆大楼。
江湾。

中午：在旗舰上举行午餐会。将邀请各国代表、中国当局及工部局人员参加。

下午2时至
4时 在旗舰上举行“居家式”招待会。

晚上：在日本俱乐部举行招待会。

（印：URGENT）

Movements of Cadets numbering 174

December 22

11.00 a.m.    Proceed to the "Idzumo".

12.30 p.m.    Leave the "Idzumo" and land at the
              Wayside Public Jetty, from whence
              they will proceed to the Naval Depot,
              229 Baikal Road, by motor buses
              supplied by various Japanese firms
              under the guidance of Japanese members
              of the S.V.C.  Following the
              inspection of the depot they will
              proceed to the Water Works where they
              will stay about 45 minutes.  From
              here they will march to the Aung Dah
              No.2 Cotton Mill.

3.45 p.m.     Leave the Mill and proceed to the
              Japanese Club by buses.

4.30 p.m.     Lecture by Mr. Yonesato, Chairman
              of the Japanese General Chamber of
              Commerce.

6.00 p.m.     Reception in the Japanese Club.

8.00 p.m.     Leave Japanese Club for their ships
              on foot.

December 23

7.00 a.m.     Leave the ships for the Japanese
              Naval Landing Party by buses.

8.30 a.m.     Leave for the Japanese Cemetery,
              Chapei (buses).

9.00 a.m.     Leave for the Commercial Press
              building, Chapei (buses).

10.45 a.m.    Leave for the Jessfield Park (buses).

11.45 a.m.    Leave for the Tung Wen College (buses).

1.45 p.m.     Leave for the Zikawei Observatory (buses).

3.00 p.m.     Leave for Nanking Road (Alight from
              buses near the Race Course and then
              walk down Nanking Road sight-seeing).

5.00 p.m.     Return to their ships.

Movements of warrant officers and men

Half of the crews will be permitted ashore on
December 22 and the remaining half on December 23.

They will assemble in front of the Japanese
Consulate and proceed on foot under the guidance
of members of the Japanese Naval Landing Party
along Hongkew and North Szechuen Roads to the
Naval Landing Party Headquarters.

（印：紧急）

174名学员的行程

12月22日

上午11:00    前往“出云”号。

下午12:30    离开“出云”号，在韦斯特公共栈桥登陆，随后
              乘坐由各日本商社提供、在上海义勇队
              （S.V.C.）日本队员引导下的汽车，前
              往位于贝加尔路229号的海军仓库。检
              阅仓库后，他们将前往自来水厂，停留
              约45分钟。此后，他们将步行至公大第
              二棉纺厂。

下午3:45     离开工厂，乘巴士前往日本俱乐部。

下午4:30     由日本总商会会长米里（Yonesato）先生
              发表演讲。

下午6:00     在日本俱乐部举行招待会。

晚上8:00     离开日本俱乐部，步行返回舰船。

12月23日

上午7:00     乘巴士离开舰船，前往日本海军陆战队。

上午8:30     乘巴士前往闸北日本公墓。

上午9:00     乘巴士前往闸北商务印书馆大楼。

上午10:45    乘巴士前往极司菲尔公园（Jessfield Park）。

上午11:45    乘巴士前往同文书院。

下午1:45     乘巴士前往徐家汇天文台。

下午3:00     前往南京路（在跑马厅附近下车，然后沿
              南京路步行观光）。

下午5:00     返回舰船。

士官及水兵的行程

半数船员获准于12月22日登岸，其余半数于12月23日登岸。

他们将在日本领事馆前集合，在日本海军陆战队队员的引导下，沿虹口路和北四川路步行前往海军陆战队司令部。

warships and the
Chinese Naval Headquarters
to return the calls.
Call on Mr. A.D. Bell,
Chairman of the Shanghai
Municipal Council.

Evening : Visit to the Japanese Club, Boone
Road, to interview local leading
Japanese residents.
Reception at the Japanese Minister's
residence, No.17 Rue Pichon, French
Concession.

December 23 :

Morning : The Admiral will visit the following
places :
Headquarters of the Japanese Landing
Party,
The Japanese Cemetery, Chapei.

Kiangwan.

Powers, the Chinese Authorities and
the S.M.C. will be invited.

2 p.m. to
4 p.m. "At home" on board the Flagship.

Evening : Reception in the Japanese Club.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
File No. 11757
Special Branch, S. 2 Station,
Date December 21, 1932

Subject (in full) Arrival of the Japanese Training Squadron.

Made by D. S. Umemoto Forwarded by [Signature]

The Japanese Naval Training Squadron comprising the
"Iwate", flagship of Vice-Admiral Hyakutake, Commander, and the
"Yagumo" will arrive in Shanghai at 10 a.m. December 22 and berth
at the N.Y.K. Whangpoo Mail Wharf.

The programme during their stay in Shanghai as obtained
from Captain Kitaoka, Japanese Naval Attache, is as follows:-

December 22;
Following the arrival the Admiral will receive on board
his flagship Japanese officials and representatives of public
bodies, Naval Commanders of foreign powers and the Chinese
Naval Commander. He will then visit the Japanese Consulate-
General.

Noon; Tiffin on board the "Idzumo".

During the afternoon; Visits to foreign warships and the
Chinese Naval Headquarters to return the calls.

Call on Mr. A.D.Bell, Chairman of the
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Evening: Visit to the Japanese Club, Boone Road, to interview
local leading Japanese residents.

Reception at the Japanese Minister's residence, No. 17
Rue Pichon, French Concession.

December 23:
Morning: The Admiral will visit the following places:-
Headquarters of the Japanese Landing Party.
The Japanese Cemetery, Chapei.
The Commercial Press Building, Chapei.
Kiangwan.

Noon: Tiffin Party on board the flagship. Representatives
of the various foreign powers, the Chinese Authorities

报告

上海工部局
档案号 11757
特别科，S. 2 分站，
日期 1932年12月21日

主题（全称） 日本海军练习舰队抵沪。

制作人 D. S. Umemoto 转交人 [签名]

由司令百武（Hyakutake）中将旗舰“岩手”号（Iwate）及“八云”号（Yagumo）组成的日本海军练习舰队，将于12月22日上午10时抵达上海，并停靠日本邮船会社黄浦邮件码头。

根据日本海军武官北冈（Kitaoka）上校提供的信息，该舰队在沪期间的日程安排如下：

12月22日；
抵达后，中将将在其旗舰上接见日本官员、公共团体代表、各国海军指挥官及中国海军指挥官。随后，他将访问日本总领事馆。

中午；在“出云”号（Idzumo）舰上午餐。

下午；回访外国军舰及中国海军司令部。

拜会上海工部局总董贝尔（A.D. Bell）先生。

晚上：访问位于布恩路（Boone Road）的日本俱乐部，会见当地日本侨领。

在法租界皮雄路（Rue Pichon）17号日本公使寓所举行招待会。

12月23日：
上午：中将将访问以下地点：
日本海军陆战队司令部。
闸北日本公墓。
闸北商务印书馆大楼。
江湾。

中午：在旗舰上举行午餐会。各国代表、中国当局
